story.titleZh: 梅赛德斯：拉塞尔领跑优势扩大至8.5秒，安东内利升至第十
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在X上发布比赛第20圈（共51圈）的赛况：拉塞尔对第二名车手的领先优势已扩大到8.5秒，安东内利则升至第十位并正在追赶弗朗科。

media.altZh: 梅赛德斯：拉塞尔领跑优势扩大至8.5秒，安东内利升至第十

story.originalTitle: Lap 20/51: George is still building his gap to P2 and is up to 8.5 seconds now! He’ll be looking to build that gap as much as possible to give him th...
story.summaryEn:
Lap 20/51:
George is still building his gap to P2 and is up to 8.5 seconds now! He’ll be looking to build that gap as much as possible to give him the best chance when he pits 🙌
Kimi is up to P10 and is hunting down Franco 🦈
detailZh:
第20圈（共51圈）：
拉塞尔仍在扩大与第二名车手的差距，目前已达到8.5秒！他会尽可能拉大这个优势，为之后进站时争取最好的机会🙌
安东内利已升至第十位，正在追赶弗朗科🦈
detailEn:
Lap 20/51:
George is still building his gap to P2 and is up to 8.5 seconds now! He’ll be looking to build that gap as much as possible to give him the best chance when he pits 🙌
Kimi is up to P10 and is hunting down Franco 🦈
keyPointsZh: 比赛共51圈，当时进行到第20圈
扩大领先优势是为拉塞尔之后进站创造更好条件
keyPointsEn: The race was on lap 20 of 51 at the time
Building the gap is aimed at giving Russell the best chance when he pits
